title: Last Stone Weight

statement.hi: Stones ke weights ka array `stones` diya hai. Har turn me do **sabse bhaari** stones `x ≤ y` ko takrao: `x == y` ho to dono khatam, warna `x` khatam aur `y` ka naya weight `y - x`. Jab tak ek ya zero stone na bache, ye repeat karo. Aakhri stone ka weight return karo (koi na bache to `0`).
statement.en: Given an array `stones` of stone weights, each turn smash the two **heaviest** stones `x ≤ y`: if `x == y` both are destroyed, otherwise `x` is destroyed and `y` becomes `y - x`. Repeat until at most one stone is left. Return the weight of the last stone, or `0` if none remain.

hi: Baar-baar do sabse bade elements chahiye — kaunsa data structure?
Max-heap: do pop karo, fark non-zero ho to wapas push karo.
en: You repeatedly need the two largest elements — which data structure?
Max-heap: pop two, and push back the difference if it is non-zero.

approach.hi: Saare stones max-heap me daalo. Jab tak heap me 2+ stones hain: do top pop karo, fark `y - x` non-zero ho to wapas push. End me heap khaali to `0`, warna top. O(n log n) time, O(n) space.
approach.en: Put all stones in a max-heap. While it has 2+ stones, pop the top two and push back `y - x` if non-zero. At the end return `0` if the heap is empty, else its top. O(n log n) time, O(n) space.
